summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmod +x's the binary, and then invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js shipped in the tarball. setup.mjs is identifier-obfuscated (_0xXXXXXX names, per-call string-property lookup objects) to hide the download URL, execution target, and platform gating. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file using a rotated string/numeric constant array with character-code reassembly — a string-array obfuscator pattern. The package presents itself as a React repo-config helper, a role that has no need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime or ship an opaque obfuscated blob to execute under it. Fetching a second runtime specifically to execute bundled obfuscated code at install time evades Node-based scanners and drops attacker-controlled execution into the installer's environment on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
